description: BC incremental L1 capture (mode auto): pass 1 is a full content read of every pinned BC Production company x the capture entity sets into a throwaway store; pass 2 reads each unit without calculated fields with the typed $filter=lastModifiedDateTime ge <watermark - 10 min> (sets with calculated fields are read in full; lines re-read except unchanged posted invoices whose last lines read was clean); pass 3 is the key-only full pass on the sets without calculated fields ($select=id,lastModifiedDateTime; a key whose etag and lastModifiedDateTime match the stored version is confirmed, any other is read by id; keys BC no longer lists are marked missing_from_source_since). Then an offline resolve of a sample of capture handles. Output is counts, states, modes, times and error classes only; never a value, number, name or citation.
notes: live-unverified until a live-check result exists. What it proves or refutes: (1) BC accepts the unquoted Edm.DateTimeOffset literal in $filter=lastModifiedDateTime ge ... on every capture set (a 400 shows as a failed unit with reason source_refused in pass 2); (2) a nextLink must repeat the request's own query (the same $filter/$select/$orderby values, adding only aid, $skiptoken and a $top no higher than the request's) and be one the GET guard sends (no raw space, control character or malformed % escape). Any other one, including a nextLink that DROPS the filter, is refused where it arrives and never followed: the unit fails with reason nextlink_refused, its cursor is dropped and the next pass restarts it from its first page (a refused lines continuation marks that document's lines incomplete instead). nextlink_refused_per_pass counts them and must be 0 in every pass, so a refusal fails this check. If BC drops or re-encodes the filter in its nextLinks, every multi-page delta unit shows up here: a real finding (the BC continuation shape is UNVERIFIED live); (3) sets with declared calculated fields (items, customers, vendors, document headers, itemLedgerEntries; grammar BC_CALCULATED_FIELDS) stay on full content reads in every pass (full_reason calculated_fields), so modes_per_pass should read [[full],[full,incremental],[full]] (purchaseReceipts and salesShipments delta; posted-invoice line units skip) and requests_per_pass[1] well below [0] except for line reads (one GET per header; posted invoices whose header did not change are skipped, lines_skipped_per_pass[1]); (4) pass 3 key-only: keys_refetched_per_pass[2] near 0 means BC's etag under $select=id,lastModifiedDateTime equals the full record's etag; a count near the record count means it does not and the key-only pass costs one GET per record (a real finding: drop keys_only). rows_changed_per_pass[2] > 0 on a unit whose pass-2 delta saw nothing means content changed without lastModifiedDateTime moving past the watermark (the capture then keeps that unit on full reads). A pass that runs out of its 700 s budget leaves units in_progress (resumable) and is reported, never counted complete; with 3 passes a budget stop in pass 1 makes later passes resume rather than run their own mode. Watermark minus 10 min overlap; full pass weekly, daily after a pass found a missing key (docs/decisions/2026-10-02-bc-capture-incremental.md). Unserved sets (bc-capture-incomplete-units, later ask bc-unserved-endpoints): a unit BC refuses with a 400 whose BC code is Internal_DataNotFoundFilter (http_400:internal_data_not_found_filter) while another company completed the same set in the call is unserved: it stays state failed / reason source_refused, never counts in units_complete, and is listed under unserved_units (company_index, book, entity_set, later_ask) and counted in units_unserved; its lines unit, failed with the header's reason, is listed too. Such a unit carries later_ask and accounted true; units_complete + units_unserved == units_total makes all_complete true, and complete_when asks accounted (complete or unserved) for every unit instead of state complete, so the check completes or names only the units no later ask backs. A set no company served, a 401/403 and any other BC code stay unaccounted. A lines unit open because its header unit is paused (headers_incomplete) carries the header unit's error. Injected-transport tested (integrations/tests/test_bc_capture.py); live-unverified. Production / My Company scope (bc-production-my-company-live): only My Company is pinned and read, so companies_captured is exactly 1; salesInvoices deltas combine the posted-only term: $filter=status ne 'Draft' and lastModifiedDateTime ge <instant> (UNVERIFIED live, same as the modified-since literal).
